production_baseline.hash_basis: Raw file bytes; entry hashes are SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify(entry) preserving parsed key order.

method: Read frozen source observations, source metadata, complete entry projections and context boundaries; independently assess lexical fit, idiom, selected sense and editorial level.
Verify raw hashes for all 13 author inventory artifacts, two execution/inventory witnesses and all 353 recorded production source files.

Read-only static JSON hashing reconstructs the registry, 200 memberships and 20 containing modules, checks all ten entry/preimage/projection hashes, 17 inherited expression holds, prior collect/notify holds and complete image mismatch.
Compare current snapshots for all 39 screened expressions, four focus expressions and 43 related lexical identities. No application validator, author script, Node test, native test or build was run.
limitations: Original publisher pages were not reopened in this independent pass, as instructed by the coordinator. Oxford body hashes and minimal attributes are author-captured evidence; the absent HTML bodies cannot be rehashed. Collins rendered semantics and levels are author-recorded observations, not a fresh independent source retrieval.

The source URLs, selected sense IDs and Oxford metadata cross-bind consistently, including assist redirecting to assist_1. This confirms frozen evidence consistency, not publisher-page authenticity or continued availability.
Editorial levels are scoped teaching judgments, not psychometric CEFR certification. Preserve literal source disagreements, missing labels, Oxford fkcefr and Collins B1+.
The 39-expression classification screen is reviewed as frozen author evidence; static comparison confirms its current snapshots. No new exhaustive expression-search test was dispatched.
No human, specialist, whole-expression, morphology, media, domain, module or release acceptance is granted. This artifact does not perform production integration or review-gate transitions.
